notes: Canonical import wave from the tenth curated Freeads capture batch.

Japanese Chin is chosen first because it adds a tiny, calm and gentler toy-companion branch without collapsing into the more guarded Pekingese or the more people-dependent Havanese/Havanese-like lane.

German Shorthaired Pointer is added as a high-drive gundog profile, reviewed away from the overly convenient raw alone-tolerance signal so it remains a demanding sporting dog rather than a generic easy active family default.

Cairn Terrier closes the wave as a small scrappy terrier with easier coat upkeep than Westie and less working intensity than Border Terrier, while still carrying prey-drive and vocal terrier constraints.
Fixtures are generated semi-assisted and still require catalog validation and ranking coverage.
